notes.title: 'Toymaker's Apprentice' now supports smooth locomotion!
notes.content: Due to overwhelming requests, we have added smooth locomotion (technically a cross between 'artificial smooth' and 'armswinger' locomotion) to the latest Steam update.   User can choose either teleportation (via beam cast) or smooth locomotion via 'back-and-forth' movement of the controllers while lightly touching the touchpad.   It's still in early testing phase, so appreciate user feedback.

notes.title: Keep the feedback coming..
notes.content: We've uploaded several patches over last week based on user feedback.    We really appreciate all the great insights as it helps us provide users an even better experience.   Fine tuning the narrator 'hints' system is next on our punch list.

notes.title: The game is live on Steam!
notes.content:
Thanks for everyone's patience as we stumbled through the release process.
The game is relatively stable.  There are a few issues we're working to address, and we should have a patch for those in the next week.
